title: Two Elixir stacks define the same namespaces with divergent implementations
evidence: 28 shared module names between lib/ and tiannara_runtime/lib/; Tiannara.Sentinel 82 vs 89 modules with 3 in common; Tiannara.OED 12 vs 33 with 9 shared; A10 6+6; CIS 4+4
closure_criteria: For every shared module name exactly one implementation exists and is the running one; the other is deleted or reduced to a delegating shim; a test asserts no namespace is defined in two stacks

title: Environmental-awareness subsystem is forked across two stacks
evidence: lib/tiannara/sentinel/ 82 modules; tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/sentinel/ 89 modules; only 3 names in common; 8 of the S2 modules are empty GenServer shells with capability-claiming docstrings
closure_criteria: One Sentinel survives; it is started by exactly one supervision tree; the empty monitoring modules in the surviving copy are implemented or removed

title: Memory subsystem is fragmented with no single owner
evidence: Tiannara.Memory 8 modules (S1); Tiannara.REA.OrbitMemory 14 (S1); TiannaraRuntime.Memory 1 module (S2); mindcache/ at repo root not integrated
closure_criteria: One memory authority exists with a documented interface; other stacks call it rather than storing knowledge themselves

title: Autonomous research is split across four Elixir namespaces plus Python
evidence: TiannaraRuntime.WorldModel.AutonomousResearch 32; TiannaraRuntime.AutonomousResearch 26; TiannaraRuntime.CausalDiscovery 25; Tiannara.ASC.Research 17; Tiannara.REA.Epistemic 24; Tiannara.Research 16; tiannara_core/research
closure_criteria: One research pipeline owns question formation through report production; other implementations become stages of it

title: Coordination layer exists twice with different vocabularies
evidence: Tiannara.CEL 50 modules (S1); Tiannara.OPC 86 (S2); Tiannara.Meta 6 (S1) and 52 (S2); TiannaraRuntime.CCOS 9; Tiannara.OSE 13
closure_criteria: One coordination vocabulary is authoritative; the other namespace is retired or aliased to it

title: Seven user-facing surfaces with no consolidation decision
evidence: tiannara_observatory/ (965 .ex, 157 .exs, 101 .tsx); tiannara_gui/; tiannara_mobile/; tiannara_saas/; tiannara-desktop/; tiannara_internal_dashboard/; tiannara_pros/; plus Tiannara.Observatory 20 and Tiannara.Interface 10 (S1)
closure_criteria: A written decision names the primary interface and the fate of each other surface; the interface reads from the store the reasoning layer writes to

title: No epistemic-status vocabulary for knowledge or environment
evidence: No owner for observed/inferred/simulated/unknown (spread across OED uncertainty models, Omega verification, DigitalTwin); no owner for established/hypothesis/obsolete (spread across Discovery, CRAV, OED Quarantine.SuspendedTheories, Meta)
closure_criteria: One status taxonomy is defined and adopted by every trace, memory record and environmental datum; AT-C6.1 and AT-C3.2 can be written against it

title: 472 hollow modules with capability-claiming docstrings
evidence: 280 in lib/ (17% of files); 192 in tiannara_runtime/lib/ (15%); detected as @moduledoc >100 chars with public API <= 1
closure_criteria: Each hollow module is either implemented, marked @doc false as internal, or deleted; the count is re-measured and reported per checkpoint

title: Ten empty GenServer shells in the Sentinel monitoring layer
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/sentinel/monitors/ (causal, collapse, ecological, emergence, pressure) and sentinel/baseline/ (anomaly_thresholds, baseline_builder, trend_memory) each contain only use GenServer + init returning {:ok, %{}} under a substantive docstring
closure_criteria: Each monitor computes a real signal and is exercised by a test that asserts a numeric output

title: Runtime-metamorphosis equivalence gate was random and never called
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/phase18/rrm/equivalence_verifier.ex implemented run_with_rules/2 as :rand.uniform(); RuleEvolution aliased the verifier but applied only the drift bound
closure_criteria: Verifier is deterministic, wired into the proposal path, and covered by exact-assertion tests

title: Drift check raised ArithmeticError on any non-numeric rule value
evidence: AdaptationController.compute_drift_delta/2 subtracted values arithmetically; :f32 - :f32 raised ArithmeticError, crashing RuleEvolution.propose_evolution on realistic rule sets
closure_criteria: Value comparison is kind-safe; tests cover numeric and non-numeric rule settings

title: Nine cloned native boundaries each hardcoding a non-existent OTP application
evidence: Application.app_dir(:tiannara_phase{9,10,11,14,15,16,17,18,19}, ...) across tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara/phase*/native_bridge.ex; zero of the 9 applications exist
closure_criteria: One shared config-driven implementation; zero hardcoded application atoms; missing accelerators fail closed with a typed reason

title: Misspelled source root held the sole implementation of seven modules
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiarnara/phase18/rrm/ defined Tiarnara.Phase18.RRM.* while Tiannara.Phase18.RRM.Supervisor referenced Tiannara.Phase18.RRM.* which did not exist
closure_criteria: Files migrated to lib/tiannara/phase18/rrm/; namespace corrected; no residual Tiarnara module in the repository; supervisor children all resolve

title: Prediction-to-observation-to-update loop does not exist
evidence: Prediction behaviours/ 4 hollow modules; counterfactual behaviours/ 3 hollow modules; autonomous_research behaviours/ 5 hollow modules
closure_criteria: A simulation produces a prediction later compared with an observed outcome; the comparison updates confidence in a replayable way (AT-C4.1, AT-C4.2)

title: No end-to-end cross-domain traversal exists
evidence: 20 canonical domains exist and are bound in lib/tiannara/domains/canonical_registry.ex, but no test traverses more than one domain in a single investigation
closure_criteria: A single investigation traverses >=3 canonical domains and emits a trace with per-domain evidence and conclusion (AT-C1.1)

title: No traceable research report contract
evidence: Research report structures are spread across TiannaraRuntime.WorldModel.AutonomousResearch and Tiannara.ASC.Research; no report artefact contract found
closure_criteria: A report artefact links every claim to a specific evidence record and reproduces identically on replay (AT-C2.3, AT-C2.4)

title: No named arbitration path between conflicting specialists
evidence: Candidates are Tiannara.ASC.Crucible (42 modules), Tiannara.OED.ACM, TiannaraRuntime.Cognitive.Engines (23); no single arbitration contract
closure_criteria: Two specialists with conflicting conclusions are arbitrated by a named process and the outcome is recorded (AT-C5.1)

title: Approved self-change is not routed through constitutional authority
evidence: RRM path proposes and verifies; application of an approved proposal is not routed through Council/CEL; direct Council.authorize/3 callers CEL.Kernel, ResourceManager, ExperimentOrchestrator, Forecasting.DecisionImpl remain disclosed unresolved consumers
closure_criteria: An unauthorised proposal is refused with a typed reason and an authorised proposal carries a valid authority record (AT-C8.2)

title: Interface does not render decision provenance or authority requests
evidence: CP19.20/21/22 produce DecisionReceipt and machine-grant provenance in the MintRegistry; Tiannara.Observatory (20 modules) and Tiannara.Interface (10) have no established binding to it
closure_criteria: For any conclusion the interface shows evidence chain, confidence and approving authority, and lists actionable authority requests (AT-C7.1, AT-C7.2)

title: No approved-source registry for environmental data
evidence: Tiannara.External has 1 module in S1; environmental ingestion appears in tiannara_api/schemas and tiannara_core/data with no shared source authority
closure_criteria: An approved-source registry exists and every environmental datum carries the source that produced it

title: Generated data and phase reports committed to the repository
evidence: tiannara_runtime/data/ holds 26020 files (~300 MB) including 4500+ checkpoints; tiannara_runtime/priv/certification/ holds thousands of phase reports across phase24_9 to phase25_9
closure_criteria: Generated artefacts are excluded from version control and reproducible from source, or are explicitly retained with a retention policy

title: RRM supervisor listed three stateless service modules as children
evidence: Tiannara.Phase18.RRM.Supervisor listed AdaptationController, MetaIRGenerator and Metrics as children; none exports child_spec/1 or start_link/1, so Supervisor.init/2 could not build the child specs and the supervisor could not start
closure_criteria: Supervisor supervises only startable processes; a test asserts every supervised child exports a usable child spec and start_link/1

title: 336 runtime modules in two clusters are never started
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara_runtime/cognitive/ (161 modules) and tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara_runtime/world_model/ (175 modules) have no supervision-tree entry and no caller outside their own cluster; together 24% of the runtime's 1376 modules
closure_criteria: Partially addressed by TCP-002.2: the Cognitive Execution Spine gives the cluster a single supervised entry point and composes 154 of the engines, but 297 of 339 modules still have no external reference and 89 reached engines remain untested

title: The forecast to outcome to calibration to model-update chain never fires
evidence: lib/tiannara/forecasting/ has 51 modules and zero callers outside its own directory; the components are real (Brier, log loss, calibration error, hindsight isolation via Outcome.guard!/2, evidence-bound OutcomeResolution, 8-status counterfactual ontology)
closure_criteria: One forecast resolves to an observed outcome and updates a recorded model confidence replayably (AT-C4.1, AT-C4.2)

title: 19 of the 20 canonical domains have no simulator
evidence: every lib/tiannara/domains/*.ex returns {:ok, []} from generate_hypotheses/1 and design_experiments/1; Domains.Cognition returns {:error, :simulation_unavailable}; only Domains.Physics has a solver (RK4 via Calculus.solve_ode/3)
closure_criteria: Each domain either has a real simulator or is explicitly declared non-simulable with a recorded reason and no false claim of capability

title: Memory promotion and retirement mechanism is orphaned
evidence: Tiannara.Memory.Ladder (9-rung evidence-gated), PromotionPipeline, IncidentDistiller and CoherenceEngine have one reference each (their own definition); no caller of KnowledgeEvolutionEngine.retire_entity/2 exists
closure_criteria: A knowledge item is promoted from hypothesis to established and retired when obsolete through a live path, both auditable events

title: No experiment can execute and no evidence-acquisition step exists
evidence: ResearchDirector.Pipeline quarantines every experiment; CEL.Workflow.Steps.Experiment and .Validation return {:error, {:unavailable, :real_step_provider_not_wired}}; no external source fetching exists in any stack; tiannara_core/api/research_routes.py has a broken import and is unregistered
closure_criteria: A research question produces competing explanations with retrieved evidence and a reproducible report (AT-C2.1..C2.4)

title: Control-centre API served fabricated data as measurements
evidence: observatory_api status_controller.ex: 11 section_* handlers with hardcoded literals (CPU 23%, Events/sec 142, discoveries 47, audit entries 1247, fabricated log timestamps); resources/2 returned :rand.uniform() values; challenges_run/2 random confidences; subsystem_status/1 returned :operational for every subsystem without checking
closure_criteria: Every fabricated payload carries epistemic_status simulated and source placeholder; subsystem health is a real liveness probe marked observed; a test pins both

title: Self-development chain is severed at delivery
evidence: Tiannara.Omega.HumanAugmentationDelivery has zero lib/ callers; Omega.GovernedEffectSink is test-only; Phase4.RealExecution is behind real_execution_enabled: false and needs a human grant nothing can mint; no producer of :improvement_proposed exists
closure_criteria: A proposal reaches a human authority request and is applied only with a valid authority record (AT-C8.2)

title: A random number is presented as a measured simulation baseline
evidence: Tiannara.Autonomy.SimulationManager measures latency_p99_us: 500 + :rand.uniform(200) and throughput_ops_sec: 5000 + :rand.uniform(2000) while Autonomy.Orchestrator.real_simulation_provider?/0 is hardcoded false
closure_criteria: Baselines are either measured from a real provider or explicitly marked unknown; no random value is reported as a measurement

title: The designated control-centre app has no UI layer
evidence: tiannara_observatory/apps/observatory_ui/ holds 55 Room components plus CommandPalette and AlertTicker but has no mix.exs and is not in the umbrella apps list; observatory_api contains 0 LiveViews and 0 .heex files; all 27 LiveViews live in lib/tiannara/web/live/ with inline ~H and no .heex exists anywhere in lib
closure_criteria: One front end is named primary, is part of the build, and reads from the store the reasoning layer writes to

title: Runtime Observatory screens are supervised but unreachable
evidence: the runtime Observatory controller expects {:ok, x} while the GenServer returns bare values, so metrics arrive as {}, screens always report :screen not available and the timeline is always empty
closure_criteria: The controller contract matches the GenServer contract and a test asserts a screen renders real data

title: Two boot paths mean supervision trees do not tell the whole truth
evidence: lib/tiannara/application.ex starts 61 children while lib/tiannara/control_center.ex starts 32 modules directly via module.start_link([]); several capability modules are reachable only through the control centre
closure_criteria: One boot path exists, or a single inventory records which path starts each module; a test asserts every capability module is reachable from a documented entry point

title: EventStore.Writer is given to a supervisor without a child spec
evidence: mix test on tiannara_observatory fails to start: ArgumentError: The module EventStore.Writer was given as a child to a supervisor
closure_criteria: The umbrella application starts and its test suite runs; the observatory_api suite is executable

title: Three directories named for capabilities are effectively empty
evidence: world_model/ contains no code; mindcache/ holds 4 files including a demo orchestrator with a hardcoded three-item fake_input; rust_core/ffi_bindings/src/lib.rs is a 5-line example_function
closure_criteria: Each directory either contains the capability it is named for, or is removed and its intent recorded in the register

title: Cognitive Execution Spine established as the integration contract
evidence: tiannara_runtime/lib/tiannara_runtime/cognitive/spine/{cognitive_execution_spine.ex,ports.ex,spine_server.ex}; supervised in TiannaraRuntime.Execution.Supervisor via optional_child; 16 tests in tiannara_runtime/test/cognitive/spine/cognitive_execution_spine_test.exs
closure_criteria: The Spine sequences existing engines through six stages plus two fail-closed gates, with a traceable entry point and a trace per stage

title: Two duplicate CognitiveContext modules with different shapes and no owner
evidence: TiannaraRuntime.Cognitive.CognitiveContext (cognitive/cognitive_context.ex) and TiannaraRuntime.Cognitive.Runtime.CognitiveContext (cognitive/runtime/cognitive_context.ex) both exist; ContextBuilder targets the first, the rest of the runtime targets neither
closure_criteria: Exactly one CognitiveContext survives; every consumer uses it; the other is removed or reduced to a delegating shim

title: Engines disagree on the shapes of mission and evidence
evidence: CognitiveContext.generate_id/1 interpolates the mission and so requires a string, while GoalDecomposer.decompose/1 reads mission.objective and requires a map; ConfidenceEstimator.estimate/1 takes evidence records while UncertaintyAnalyzer.aleatoric/1 takes plain numbers
closure_criteria: All engines share one documented mission and evidence shape, or the Spine's seam normalisation is promoted into a shared contract module

title: 89 of the 154 engines reachable through the Spine remain untested
evidence: the activation map records 286 of 339 modules with no test reference; subpackages with no tested engine include cognitive/engines (23 engines), cognitive/decision (8), cognitive/metacognition (7), cognitive/reflection (7), cognitive/runtime (6), world_model/counterfactual (17), world_model/prediction (9)
closure_criteria: Every engine the Spine invokes has at least one test that asserts a real output, not merely that the function returns

title: Forecasting chain in the application stack is still orphaned
evidence: lib/tiannara/forecasting/ has 51 modules with zero callers outside its own directory; the Spine does not cover it because it lives in the application stack, not the runtime
closure_criteria: A forecast resolves to an observed outcome and updates a persisted, evidence-bound calibration record (AT-C4.1, AT-C4.2); the Spine or the application workflow invokes it

title: Research adapter presented a heuristic as measured information gain
evidence: Tiannara.Forecasting.Adapters.ResearchImpl.information_gain_estimate/2 returned {:ok, 1.0 / length(existing)} when SignalValue.measure produced no numeric gain; a reciprocal of the size of the existing set is not an information gain, and the :ok slot made it indistinguishable from a measurement
closure_criteria: The fallback is the contract's honest state {:error, :insufficient_data}; the measured path is unchanged; both the empty and non-empty cases are tested

title: Forecast registry was ephemeral and its lineage unrecoverable
evidence: ForecastRegistry.init/1 deleted the ETS table on every start and the durable event carried only {forecast_id, question, version}, so history was lost on restart and could not have been replayed from the log either
closure_criteria: The EventStore log holds the full forecast; init/1 replays it into the index and the request index; count/0 reports registrations rather than index size; recover/0 exposes the replay

title: Forecast registry health reported durability that did not exist
evidence: health/0 returned eventstore_degraded: state.eventstore_degraded, which was only ever false; maybe_append_event swallowed every failure with try/catch -> :ok, so a failing event store was reported as healthy
closure_criteria: A failed append logs and sets eventstore_degraded; health/0 reports eventstore_degraded, durable, forecast_count and recovered_count

title: The canonical forecasting subsystem was never supervised in the application
evidence: Neither Tiannara.Forecasting.ForecastRegistry nor a boundary module was in the application supervision tree; register_forecast/1 from the application raised no process, so EFDI could not run at all
closure_criteria: The registry and the bridge are supervised; the registry is behind :supervise_forecast_registry so the forecasting suites keep per-test isolation

title: No path existed by which the runtime Spine could obtain a probabilistic forecast
evidence: The Spine forecast stage called only Cognitive.Metacognition.ConfidenceEstimator and UncertaintyAnalyzer; confidence and probability are different quantities and no probabilistic forecast was reachable
closure_criteria: The Spine requests a probabilistic forecast through the forecasting port; the port refuses by default with :forecast_engine_unavailable; confidence and probability are reported separately and never interchanged

title: The application and runtime stacks cannot share a compile-time dependency
evidence: 28 module names are defined in both stacks (Tiannara.Sentinel.*, Tiannara.OED.*, Tiannara.A10.*, Tiannara.CIS.*, Tiannara.P9X.*, Tiannara.Core.Ontology.Index, Tiannara.Meta.CausalTensegrityEngine, CivilizationState); a single BEAM would redefine them
closure_criteria: The stacks are consolidated into one namespace with one implementation each, after which the boundary may be simplified; until then the versioned contract is the sanctioned path

title: Research Director does not create EFDI forecast requests
evidence: the Research Director pipeline quarantines every experiment and CEL workflow steps return {:error, {:unavailable, :real_step_provider_not_wired}}; no stage of the research flow constructs a forecast request with a target, outcome space, horizon, resolution criteria and evidence
closure_criteria: A research question produces an EFDI forecast request with a defined outcome contract and a reproducible report (AT-C2.1..C2.4)

title: No source of observed outcomes is wired to outcome resolution
evidence: OutcomeResolution and TemporalFirewall are implemented but no provider supplies real observed outcomes; outcome resolution has therefore never run against real data
closure_criteria: An eligible outcome source resolves forecasts with independent verification, and the temporal firewall is proven by an adversarial test

title: Calibration has never run against eligible resolved forecasts
evidence: Calibration, ForecastAuditor, PerformanceLedger and TemporalEvaluation are implemented; the forecast -> outcome -> calibration -> model-update chain has never executed
closure_criteria: Calibration runs against eligible resolved forecasts with sample size and reference class reported; single resolutions are never presented as certification

title: Durable forecast registry has no adversarial persistence suite
evidence: the registry now persists to the EventStore log and replays on start, but corruption, truncation, replay, duplicate delivery, concurrent registration and partial-write recovery are untested
closure_criteria: An adversarial persistence suite covers corruption, truncation, replay, duplicate events, concurrent writes and restart recovery

title: D6 institutional forecasting memory is deferred and 65 of 70 EFDI modules hold no state
evidence: EFDI status/0 lists :memory under deferred; the inventory records persistence in only 5 of 70 modules; validated lessons must enter the canonical knowledge lifecycle rather than a second memory
closure_criteria: Forecast performance, validated discoveries and institutional lessons enter the existing governed knowledge lifecycle with explicit epistemic status

title: EFDI public API documentation contradicts its implementation
evidence: lib/tiannara/forecasting/efdi.ex states D1 STOPS here and does not forecast, calibrate, decide, while the same module implements forecast/1, score_forecast/2, decide/1 and the D4 counterfactual API
closure_criteria: The moduledoc describes the implemented D1-D5 surface and the deferred D6, or is corrected to match the code
